FX-IOK-001.says: The settings as they start: Foreground 0 (none): nothing is keyed, the picture as it was.

FX-IOK-002.says: Foreground mask 1 just inside the yellow block, Background mask 2 two pixels outside it: the block kept, the blue outside the outer mask gone, the edge mixtures between them see-through as much as they are blue, their colour the yellow without the blue.

FX-IOK-003.says: One mask, the inner one, Single Mask Highlight Radius 1.2: the pixels whose centres lie within 1.2 of its outline are worked out, the rest kept inside it and gone outside.

FX-IOK-004.says: One mask with the radius as added, 10: every pixel of this small picture lies within 10 of the outline, so nothing is surely kept and every pixel goes.

FX-IOK-005.says: FX-IOK-002 with Invert Extraction: the block is gone and the blue kept.

FX-IOK-006.says: Edge Thin 1: the matte shrinks a pixel all round.

FX-IOK-007.says: Edge Thin -1: the matte grows a pixel all round.

FX-IOK-008.says: Edge Feather 2: the matte's edge softens.

FX-IOK-009.says: Edge Threshold 50: the half-kept pixels and less go, the rest harden.

FX-IOK-010.says: Blend With Original 50: half way between FX-IOK-002 and the picture.

FX-IOK-011.says: Edge Thin 1.5, Edge Feather 3 and Edge Threshold 20 together, in that order.

FX-IOK-012.says: One mask, the radius keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 1.2 at frame 4: a hard cut along the outline at frame 0; at frame 2, 0.6, the pixels either side of its straight sides are worked out; at frame 4 its corners too.

FX-IOK-013.says: Blend With Original keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4: FX-IOK-002, half way, then the picture.

FX-IOK-014.says: The inner mask's path keyed two rows lower by frame 4: the kept part follows it, frames 0, 2 and 4.

FX-IOK-015.says: FX-IOK-002 moved three pixels right: the key moves with the layer.

FX-IOK-016.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the masks are the drawing's own, so they key the drawing's place in the grown buffer, whose copies lie outside the outer mask and are gone.

FX-IOK-017.says: Foreground 1.5 and Background 2.7: their floors, FX-IOK-002's frame.

FX-IOK-018.says: Foreground and Background the same mask: nothing is unknown, a hard cut along it.

FX-IOK-019.says: A foreground mask right of the picture: nothing is kept, so every pixel goes.

FX-IOK-020.says: A background mask round the whole picture: nothing is gone, so every pixel is kept as it was.

FX-IOK-021.says: One curved mask, a circle 8 across about (8, 5), radius 1.2.

FX-IOK-022.says: Blend With Original keyed from 40 at frame 0 to 100 at frame 4 by an ease that passes its end: held at 100 at frame 2, where it would pass it.

FX-IOK-023.says: Foreground 0 with a background named: still none, the picture as it was.

FX-IOK-024.says: Edge Threshold 100: only the wholly kept pixels stay, whole.

FX-IOK-025.says: Foreground 1 with no masks at all. Nothing to key by: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-IOK-026.says: Foreground 3, of two. Nothing to key by: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-IOK-027.says: Background 3, of two. Nothing to key by: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-IOK-028.says: Foreground 1, switched off. Nothing to key by: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-IOK-029.says: Background 2, switched off. Nothing to key by: the layer is drawn without the effect, which is kept as written, and EFFECT_PATH_MISSING is said every frame.

FX-IOK-030.says: Foreground -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-031.says: Background 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-032.says: Single Mask Highlight Radius -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-033.says: Edge Thin -101, below -100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-034.says: Edge Thin 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-035.says: Edge Feather 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-036.says: Edge Threshold 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-037.says: Blend With Original 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-038.says: Invert Extraction "yes", not off or on. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-IOK-039.says: Blend With Original keyed to 101 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
